originalTitle: Nigeria's president orders manhunt after kidnappers upload victim video
title: Good News! Our Helpers Are Working to Bring Missing Families Home!
content:
Hello, super kids of Africa! Are you ready for some news from our amazing continent? Today, we have a very important story. Sometimes, sad things happen, but guess what? We have many helpers who care a lot and are working hard to make things better!

Some Families Are Missing

In a country called Nigeria, which is a big and beautiful part of Africa, something a little sad happened. Some grown-ups and children went missing. They were in a place with lots of trees, like a big forest. Many people are very sad and worried about them right now. It’s like when your favourite toy goes missing, and you feel a little sad inside. Everyone hopes to find these families very, very soon.

Our President is a Big Helper!

In Nigeria, there is a very important person called the President. The President is like the main leader of the country. His job is to make sure everyone is safe and happy. Our President of Nigeria, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, heard about the missing families. He felt very sad, just like everyone else. But he didn't just feel sad; he decided to act! He wants to make sure all the missing people, especially the children, come back home safe and sound. Did you know? A President is like the head teacher of a whole country! They make big decisions to help everyone living there.

What is a "Manhunt"?

The President asked all the special helpers to start a "manhunt." Now, that's a big word, but it just means looking for someone very, very hard! It's like when you lose your favourite teddy bear, and all your family looks everywhere for it – under the bed, behind the curtains, in the garden! Our President wants the police and soldiers to look everywhere for these families. They are looking in the big forests and in every corner to find them. They are using cars, maybe even some special gadgets, to search far and wide.

Who Are Our Community Helpers?

We have so many amazing helpers in our communities. Police officers are like superheroes in uniforms. They help people who are lost, stop bad guys, and keep our roads safe. Soldiers are also very brave; they help protect our country and everyone in it. These helpers are working together like a big team. They are all following clues and talking to people to find out where the families might be. They won't stop until they bring everyone home. Did you know? Police officers often wear special uniforms so you can easily spot them if you need help! They are always ready to lend a hand.

Why Do Bad Things Happen?

Sometimes, there are people who do not make good choices. These people are sometimes called kidnappers. They took the families away, and that was a very wrong thing to do. We don't like it when people make bad choices that hurt others. But it's important to remember that there are many, many more good people in the world than bad ones. And all the good people are working together to fix this sad situation.

Staying Safe Together

As kids, it's super important to always stay safe. Always listen to your grown-ups – your mum, dad, grandmas, grandpas, and teachers. They know what's best for you and want to keep you out of harm's way. If someone you don't know tries to talk to you or asks you to go somewhere, remember to always say "No!" and run to a grown-up you trust right away. It's like a special safety rule! Did you know? Your parents and teachers teach you how to be safe and smart! Listening to them is like learning super-safety powers!

Hope for Everyone!

We know that the police, the soldiers, and all the helpers are working super, super hard. They are trying their best to bring all the missing grown-ups and children back to their homes and families. We send our warmest wishes and good thoughts to everyone in Nigeria. We hope that the families will be found very soon, safe and sound. We believe in the power of our helpers and the good hearts of people everywhere. Let's all hope for a happy ending and keep thinking positive thoughts for these families. We know our helpers are doing everything they can to bring smiles back to their faces! Stay safe and keep being amazing, African kids!
summary: The President of Nigeria has asked police and soldiers to search everywhere for families, including children, who went missing, hoping to bring them home safely.
whyMatters: This is important because everyone deserves to be safe and with their families, and our helpers are working hard to protect us and bring home anyone who is lost.
